lots.working: Keep: lowest surviving SOLD AUD 100 / 1.22 = 81.97, round down to $80 (all-in $97.60). Flip: likely resale AUD 100 less eBay fees about 13% ($13) and outbound postage about $20 = $67; $67 / 2.44 = 27.46, round down to $25 (all-in $30.50). Both rest on one unverified 2021 snippet for a presumably complete copy; this box is worn and the discs are not shown, so treat these as ceilings, not targets. The other LPs add perhaps $2-5 each at resale.
lots.confidence_reason: Box title read clearly in photos, but the only SOLD evidence is a single unverified snippet from 2021 and the discs are not seen.
lots.dropped_entries: Dropped: popsike 2010 GBP 43 (16 years old, snippet only, not usable). ebay.de 187735432320 at AU $280 and at GBP 19 (the same URL was credited with two contradictory prices, so neither can be trusted). Stereonet GBP 100 (researcher unsure whether it was Stereonet or eBay, and a GBP price on an Australian classifieds board is doubtful; page blocked). Dire Straits Alchemy Live SOLD US$39.99 and GBP 9.77 (different item from the box, snippet only, pages blocked; not needed for the guide). Every URL was blocked by the egress proxy on re-check.
lots.key_photo_findings: Photo 2 shows the From Liverpool box with numbered inner sleeves 1, 2, 4, 6, 7 and 8 visible and two more partly hidden (probably 3 and 5), so all 8 sleeves are likely present. No disc, label or catalogue number is visible, so the pressing (UK EMI or Australian World Record Club) is not confirmed. Box edges worn and split at corners; sleeves creased and scuffed. Other LPs shown only as covers.
lots.condition: Box worn with corner wear and splits, inner sleeves creased, other covers shelf-worn. Disc condition unknown.
lots.question_for_armitage: Are all 8 discs present in the Beatles box, what label and catalogue number do they show, and what condition are the playing surfaces in?

Dorotheum EUR 2,816 (genuine Edo impression, not comparable, outside window). All URLs blocked by the egress proxy on re-check.
lots.key_photo_findings: Photo 4 shows the Hakone print with the Tokaido series cartouche and the Hiroshige signature and Takenouchi (Hoeido) publisher seal cut into the design, as on modern recuts. Colours are crisp and even, bokashi clean, paper uniform; this reads as Showa or later reprints rather than Edo impressions. Photo 1 shows toned sheets with creases, handling marks and trimmed or uneven margins; the Nihonbashi snow print is matted. No reprint publisher seal (such as Adachi or Takamizawa) is visible in the photos.
lots.condition: Toned paper, creases and handling marks, some trimmed or irregular edges; colours still bright.
lots.question_for_armitage: Are there any publisher or reprint seals or pencil notes in the margins, and what are the sheet sizes? Any sign of earlier (Meiji or Edo) impressions?
